items.behavior: Saved rows are entered manually from the values you want to keep.
Edits and archives are visible in local operation history.

The live calculator does not auto-write a history row when you press equals.

components.title: Modes & Boundaries
components.subtitle: Angle mode, local behavior, accessibility, and unsupported claims.

components.title: Current behavior
components.subtitle: The workbench is explicit about what happens locally and what does not.

items.behavior: The segmented control on the workbench sets the angle mode before evaluation.
MC, MR, M+, and M- are in-session only and reset when the widget resets.
Records are named and saved manually; equals does not auto-capture a row.
Convert units before entry; inline unit text is unsupported.
There are no copy or paste helpers in this workbench.

components.title: Accessibility contract
components.subtitle: Responsive target sizes, visible focus, and dynamic error text.

items.behavior: Calculator keys and segmented controls expose 44 px targets
items.boundary: Dense key layout remains tap-first rather than gesture-only

items.behavior: The expression field accepts direct typing and post-evaluation edits
items.boundary: No dedicated desktop shortcut map is exposed

items.behavior: Invalid syntax and non-finite results stay visible and screen-reader reachable
items.boundary: The app does not rewrite the expression for you

items.behavior: Phone keeps the keypad primary; wider shells keep the reference and history nearby
items.boundary: There is no separate desktop-only calculation mode

components.title: Offline state
components.subtitle: Expression evaluation and saved rows stay local-first. This package makes no sync or cloud-history claim.
